Bus-Truck Collision on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway Kills Seven

A bus carrying pilgrims collided with a truck on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway in Rajasthan's Dausa district, resulting in a fire and the deaths of at least seven people. Over 15 others were injured in the incident, which occurred early Wednesday morning. The bus was reportedly traveling from Rishikesh to Indore.
